description: QWater integrates EPANET and GHydraulics in QGIS to design water networks, export INP files, run simulations and load results. It also calculates economic diameters against a head-loss constraint. This resource is provided by jorgealmerio (repository owner). Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: GPL-3.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The GPL-3.0 plugin remains under development; generated designs require engineering review. For simulation, it can support model preparation or execution. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
